primaryAgentFindings.required: Use sum over j of the inner training-data sum times beta_j; keep the original algorithm and measured numbers unchanged

primaryAgentFindings.problem: Page 1 sourceDigest and page 3 source-file list overflow the right margin; final-pass hbox warnings confirm this

primaryAgentFindings.problem: The draft unconditionally says no PDF exists and it has never been frozen, despite the subsequent successful build

primaryAgentFindings.problem: No external validation does not prove external invalidity
primaryAgentFindings.required: Say external validity has not been evaluated, not that it cannot exist
